description_zh: 九洲大陆，武道为尊。弱者如蝼蚁，强者如神明。青州少年楚枫，一个被所有人看不起的外门弟子，凭借一件神秘至宝，觉醒了万中无一的天赐神体，从此逆天改命，踏上了一条让天地颤抖的武神之路。
description_en: In the Nine Provinces, martial strength reigns supreme. The weak are trampled like ants, while the strong stand as gods. Chu Feng, a despised outer disciple of the Azure Dragon School, awakens a legendary divine physique through a mysterious treasure, defying destiny and embarking on an epic journey to become the Martial God.

description_zh: 少年云澈，在世人眼中是一个废人。天生经脉尽断，受尽欺凌与嘲笑。直到一颗来自天外的邪神之种，与他融为一体。从那一刻起，一个被踩在脚下的废物少年，将让整个苍风大陆为之颤抖。
description_en: Yun Che was a crippled youth despised by all until a mysterious pearl from beyond the heavens fused with his body. From that moment forward, the boy once trampled underfoot would make an entire continent tremble before his might.

The epic tale of the Monkey King Sun Wukong, a Buddhist monk Tang Sanzang, and their companions Pigsy and Sandy as they journey westward to India to obtain sacred Buddhist scriptures. One of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature, this mythological adventure has captivated readers worldwide for over 400 years.

description_zh: 书生孟浩，三次科举不中，心灰意冷之际，被南域靠山宗强行收为弟子。一介凡人，如何在这残酷的修真界生存？且看他凭借一面铜镜，走上一条与众不同的封天之路。
description_en: Meng Hao, a scholar who failed the imperial exams three times, was forcibly recruited by the Reliance Sect. Armed with nothing but a bronze mirror and unwavering determination, he would forge his own unique path to sealing the heavens.

title_en: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio
description: Nearly 500 supernatural tales from Qing Dynasty China. Fox spirits, ghosts, and immortals walk among mortals in this timeless classic of Chinese weird fiction.
description_en: Nearly 500 supernatural tales from Qing Dynasty China. Fox spirits, ghosts, and immortals walk among mortals in this timeless classic of Chinese weird fiction.

description_zh: 五百年前，方源是魔道巨擘，纵横天下无可匹敌。然而，天下正道围攻，他在绝境中催动春秋蝉——一只让他重回五百年前的蛊虫。这一世，他将不惜一切代价追求永生。
description_en: Five hundred years ago, Fang Yuan was a demon lord without equal. Cornered by the righteous factions, he activated the Spring Autumn Cicada, a gu worm that sent him back five centuries. In this new life, he will stop at nothing to achieve eternal life.

The greatest historical epic of Chinese literature, chronicling the fall of the Han Dynasty and the rise of the Three Kingdoms. Filled with legendary heroes like Guan Yu and Zhuge Liang, battlefield tactics, political intrigue, and timeless lessons in loyalty and strategy. An essential read for anyone interested in Chinese history and culture.

description_zh: 白小纯，一个怕死但更怕活的少年，被李青候拐骗进了灵溪宗。从此，这个惜命如金的少年，走上了那条有去无回的修仙之路。面对无数艰难险阻，白小纯的座右铭只有一个——怕死就对了！
description_en: Bai Xiaochun, a youth terrified of death, was tricked into joining the Spirit Stream Sect. Armed with the philosophy that 'being afraid of death is correct,' he stumbles his way into becoming one of the most legendary cultivators in history.

description: The great war between the Shang and Zhou dynasties becomes a battlefield for gods and demons. Jiang Ziya must bestow divine titles upon the fallen.
description_en: The great war between Shang and Zhou becomes a battlefield for gods and demons. Jiang Ziya must bestow divine titles upon the fallen in this epic of Chinese mythology.

description_zh: 我嫁给了皇帝，却从不曾得到他的真心。当外邦的奴隶被册封为妃，我知道我们的婚姻已经走到了尽头。但我没有流泪，也没有哀求。我要堂堂正正地离开，然后在另一个国度重新开始。
description_en: Navier was the perfect empress, but her husband the emperor never loved her. When he brings a slave girl into the palace and makes her his concubine, Navier doesn't cry or beg. She divorces him — and finds a new beginning in a neighboring kingdom.

Considered the pinnacle of Chinese fiction, this sprawling masterpiece follows the rise and fall of the aristocratic Jia family. A profound exploration of love, fate, and the impermanence of worldly glory. Set against the backdrop of 18th century Qing Dynasty society, it weaves together over 400 characters in a tapestry of unparalleled complexity.

description_zh: 她以为自己只是他众多女人中的一个。直到有一天，她发现自己成了他最想占有的猎物。在她和总裁展开的秘密恋情中，权力的游戏远比爱情更为凶险。
description_en: She thought she was just one of his many women — until she realized she had become the prey he wanted most. In their secret affair with the CEO of a powerful corporation, the game of power proves far more dangerous than the game of love.

description_zh: 这里是属于斗气的世界，没有花俏艳丽的魔法，有的，仅仅是繁衍到巅峰的斗气！少年萧炎，三年前曾是家族中百年难遇的修炼天才，如今却沦为废人，受尽冷眼。直到他从戒指中唤醒了一个神秘的灵魂...
description_en: In a world of Dou Qi where magic doesn't exist, Xiao Yan was once a genius cultivator who lost everything. Reduced to a laughingstock, he discovers a mysterious soul residing in his mother's ring — and his journey to reclaim his power begins.

description: Lemuel Gulliver voyages to Lilliput, Brobdingnag, Laputa, and beyond — a timeless adventure of wonder, satire, and dark truth about human nature.
description_en: Lemuel Gulliver voyages to Lilliput, Brobdingnag, Laputa, and beyond — a timeless adventure of wonder, satire, and dark truth about human nature.

The legendary tale of 108 outlaws who gather at Mount Liangshan to form an army of righteous rebels. Fighting against corrupt officials and oppressive rulers, these colorful heroes embody the timeless spirit of brotherhood and justice. The original Chinese 'band of misfits' epic, predating modern team-up stories by centuries.

description_zh: 王林，一个资质平庸的普通少年，为了给父母报仇，他踏上了修真之路。逆天而行，以凡人之躯走完了修真界最艰难的道路，开创了一条前所未有的仙逆之路。
description_en: Wang Lin, an ordinary youth with mediocre talent, steps onto the path of cultivation to avenge his parents. Defying the heavens at every turn, he walks the most grueling road in the cultivation world, creating a path of immortal defiance never seen before.

description_zh: 一夜荒唐，她惹上帝国总裁。她以为天亮之后就是陌生人了，谁知道他拿着一纸婚书，将她的人生彻底改写。五年的隐婚，她以为自己只是他协议上的妻子，却不知道从第一天起，他就已经认定了她。
description_en: One reckless night entangled her with the CEO of an empire. She thought they'd be strangers by morning — but he showed up with a marriage certificate that changed her life forever. Five years of hidden marriage passed before she realized: he had chosen her from the very first day.

The world's most influential treatise on military strategy, written 2,500 years ago and still studied in military academies and business schools worldwide. Sun Tzu's timeless wisdom extends far beyond the battlefield—his principles of strategic thinking have influenced leaders from Napoleon to modern CEOs. Short, profound, and endlessly quotable.

description: Before heaven and earth, there was chaos. Witness the birth of Pangu, the mending of the sky by Nüwa, and the first gods taking their celestial thrones.
description_en: Before heaven and earth, there was chaos. Witness the birth of Pangu, the mending of the sky by Nüwa, and the first gods taking their celestial thrones.

description_zh: 在浮冰海湾的尽头，矗立着一座聚集了所有罪恶的城市。理查德，一个背负着沉重命运的年轻贵族，将在这里掀起一场席卷整个大陆的风暴。
description_en: At the edge of the Floating Ice Bay stands a city that has gathered every sin imaginable. Richard, a young noble burdened by fate, will unleash a storm here that will sweep across the entire continent.

description_zh: 人类进入星际时代，但他们的敌人从来不只是外星人。在无尽星海中，有一种古老而神秘的力量在苏醒。少年韩森，凭借一枚神秘的血脉基因，在这个残酷的宇宙中开启了他的进化之路。
description_en: Humanity has entered the interstellar age, but their enemies have never been limited to aliens. In the boundless star ocean, an ancient and mysterious power is awakening. Armed with a mysterious gene, Han Sen begins his evolutionary journey in a brutal universe.

The foundational text of Taoism and one of the most translated books in human history. Lao Tzu's 81 brief chapters contain a universe of wisdom on living in harmony with the natural order, the power of non-action (wu-wei), and the profound simplicity of the Tao. A spiritual classic that has guided seekers for 2,500 years.

description: From a stone egg atop the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, Sun Wukong is born. Follow his earliest days: the discovery of the Water Curtain Cave, his quest for immortality, and the mischief that makes him legend.
description_en: From a stone egg atop the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, Sun Wukong is born. Follow his earliest days: the Water Curtain Cave, the quest for immortality, and the mischief that makes him legend.

The collected teachings of China's greatest philosopher. Through conversations with his disciples, Confucius laid the foundation for East Asian ethics, governance, and personal cultivation. His emphasis on virtue (ren), ritual propriety (li), and the ideal of the 'gentleman' (junzi) continues to resonate across cultures.
The first Kai Lung novel — a comic masterpiece set in ancient China.
Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio — nearly 500 supernatural tales blending the eerie, the romantic, and the philosophical.

description: A thousand-year-old white snake spirit falls in love with a mortal man at West Lake. One of China's Four Great Folktales, retold for modern readers.
description_en: A thousand-year-old white snake spirit falls in love with a mortal man at West Lake. One of China's Four Great Folktales, retold for modern readers.
The oldest collection of Chinese poetry — 305 poems from the Zhou Dynasty.
A collection of English translations of classical Chinese poetry, from the Tang and Song dynasties.
The Taoist classic filled with parables, irony, and profound insight into the nature of reality.
A classic fantasy novel set in ancient China by the author of the Kai Lung series.
The extraordinary story of the leader of the Taiping Rebellion.
Volume I of Dream of the Red Chamber — translated by H. Bencraft Joly.
